overallAssessment: Prompt engineering module provides comprehensive guidance for AI script generation with multiple specialized templates

codeQuality.structure: Well-organized with clear sections for system prompt, templates, and utilities
codeQuality.typeHints: Type hints used for function signatures
codeQuality.documentation: Docstrings present for all public functions
codeQuality.constants: Good use of module-level constants for templates and keywords

systemPrompt.expected: Guides AI to generate only Blender Python scripts, no markdown or explanations
systemPrompt.actual: SYSTEM_PROMPT explicitly instructs 'Generate ONLY the Python script code. No markdown, no explanations'

bpyContext.expected: Includes context about available bpy modules
bpyContext.actual: Detailed documentation of bpy.ops.mesh, bpy.ops.object, bpy.data, bpy.context, and mathutils

promptWrapping.expected: User prompts wrapped with proper context based on generation type
promptWrapping.actual: wrap_user_prompt() detects type and applies appropriate template

runnableScripts.expected: Generated scripts should be runnable in Blender
runnableScripts.actual: System prompt includes complete bpy API patterns and script structure guidance

templates.expected: Prompt templates for different generation types
templates.actual: 8 templates: primitive, material, modifier, complex, multi_object, animation, lighting, camera

suggestions.description: Consider adding unit tests for detect_generation_type() function with various prompt inputs
